info.title: MusMove direct online APIs
info.description: Source contract, not proof of deployment. Primary spec is openapi.yaml, which references these path items. Every mutation requires a UUID Idempotency-Key plus resource versions for updates/deletes. Scope/hash/receipt and domain writes commit atomically; same account/key/normalized body replays the original successful JSON/status, different content/path rejects409. Failed transactions save no receipt. No TTL cleanup/discovery endpoint, no skip endpoint, no new SETUP_REQUIRED recommendation guard. All ownership from Bearer JWT. JSON <=64KiB, depth32; mutation responses <=256KiB, reads <=3MiB. Account120/min and writes30/min;429 honors Retry-After; errors sanitized with requestId. Legacy writes/receipts/history shapes retained; new free manual snapshots require upgraded readers, cannot be created via legacy sync/demo imports. Migration0023 changes workout-only mode type, not training mode. No new tables, cloud deployment, production personal writes or deletion of legacy device data.

get.description: Read identity, binary setup state, profile, training preferences, user preferences and all three versions without saving a draft.

200.description: Canonical account-owned state, or original successful response on exact idempotent replay.

patch.description: One atomic PATCH for changed resources only. Include exactly their baseVersions. Omission preserves, nullable null clears, nested trainingContext merges; arrays replace. setupCompleted cannot be patched. Profile/training editor requires completed onboarding; budget/area preferences may be saved independently. Optional nutrition can remain unavailable. No query parameters.

200.description: Canonical account-owned state, or original successful response on exact idempotent replay.

get.description: Owned history; from <= to. Optional mode is exact session classification: gym/calisthenics exclude mixed; omit for all modes. Preserve the same filters while paginating; reset cursor when filters change. Legacy bounded offset cursor, not a snapshot or signed collection cursor. All modes count once in unfiltered calendar/dashboard/statistics.

200.description: Canonical account-owned state, or original successful response on exact idempotent replay.

post.description: Submit once after finishing; never start/resume or per-set writes. custom/recommended require programId plus one gym/calisthenics mode and retain strict single-mode references. manual must omit programId. New free manual format omits top-level mode and requires mode per exerciseSnapshot item and exerciseMode per setLog entry; backend derives gym/calisthenics/mixed from verified references, independently of profile/setup. Legacy manual format with top-level mode and no per-exercise modes remains accepted; do not mix formats. Identity is (mode,id), never ID alone; two mode-qualified public IDs can coexist, but duplicate same-mode IDs or duplicate (mode,id,setNumber) reject400. Local/catalog shadow in the same mode rejects400 AMBIGUOUS_EXERCISE_REFERENCE rather than guessing. Canonicalize labels/requirements and verify ownership; historical owned/catalog references may be deleted/inactive. Keep actual reps/load per set unchanged. Manual-only optional newExercises: <=12 unique account-local IDs, explicit gym/calisthenics classification per new exercise matching its snapshot reference; no inference from profile/name. Existing own/tombstone/catalog ID conflicts409; foreign IDs never provide references, but a separately declared new local ID is independently owned. All exercises/workout/events/receipt commit or roll back together. <=12 exercises, <=120 logs, <=10 sets per exercise; frontend starts new selections at1 set, backend accepts1–10 and does not overwrite it with defaults. Fresh responses return item plus canonical created exercises; exact retry replays saved response, including legacy item-only receipts, with no duplicate writes. Changed body/key reuse409. completed only; full performed snapshots are immutable, not rebuilt from a program. finishedAt>=startedAt, recordedOn>=1900-01-01 and within1 day of UTC start day. New mixed shape requires migration0023 and upgraded readers before activation; see frontend-follow-up-record-workout-free-mode.md.

CompletedWorkoutInput.description: Measurement defaults to legacy repetitions when trackingType is absent. duration requires null target reps and targetDurationSeconds1–3600; actual setLog durationSeconds1–3600 or null/omitted unknown, null actual reps. Zero hold seconds is invalid, zero repetition count/extra load is valid. Completed may have unknown actuals; not proof all target sets were done. Session timing is retained: manual sessionTiming user_reported requires1–43200 seconds including rest; timer derives positive elapsed seconds from timestamps and forbids supplied seconds. Program timing may only use timer. No timing means unknown duration, never sum holds. Workout calorie estimation has been removed. energyActivityCode and workoutBodyweightKg are no longer accepted (400, even if null). New resultMetrics version2 contains duration and muscles only, without energy; historical version1 reads/receipts are preserved. No profile weight/age is needed to calculate workout metrics. Snapshot muscleTargets supplied by client are not authoritative and are replaced by canonical data or null. resultMetrics is server-only and rejected as input. See frontend-follow-up-workout-without-calories.md and frontend-follow-up-workout-result-metrics.md; migration0024 remains required for result_metrics storage and nullable readers.

CurrentWorkoutResultMetrics.description: Version2: elapsed session duration and canonical muscle coverage only. No calorie/MET estimate or bodyweight snapshot.

energy.description: Retired opaque energy snapshot. Historical reads only; ignore in UI. Never generated for new workouts.

LegacyWorkoutResultMetrics.description: Version1 immutable historical snapshot only. Ignore retired energy in the UI. Original reads/receipts are preserved, never recalculated.

resultMetrics.description: Persisted at final submit only; null for old history. Never regenerated from today's profile/catalog.

Workout.description: Legacy/program snapshots retain their original shape. New free manual snapshots carry exercise.mode and setLog.exerciseMode throughout; their session mode is derived, mixed only when both modes occur. mixed is completed manual only. Identity is the (mode,id) pair, including each log reference and duplicate-set check. Read-only compatibility streams preserve this shape; legacy sync/demo writes cannot create it. Older two-value enum readers must be upgraded before mixed data is enabled.

exercises.description: Canonical newly created exercises in request order, with string versions; empty for fresh submissions without newExercises. Optional only because pre-upgrade saved receipts replay the original item-only response unchanged.

CustomExercisePatch.description: Measurement defaults are validated after merging changes with existing state; omitted trackingType preserves it. Measurement kind and mode are immutable for an existing exercise ID.
